_about: Public-domain F. W. Faber (Frederick William Faber, 1814-1863, Tractarian, then priest of the London Oratory) for the Word Hoard: 19 books from Internet Archive scans, 1838-1866, from his Anglican tracts to All for Jesus (1854), Growth in Holiness (1855), The Creator and the Creature (1857), The Foot of the Cross (1858), Spiritual Conferences (1859), The Precious Blood and Bethlehem (1860). His hymns and poems wait in alternates. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
